notes: IRPEF brackets: three-bracket structure per L. 199/2025 (Legge di Bilancio 2026); second bracket reduced from 35% to 33% effective 2026-01-01.

INPS rates: credito sector (Credito e Assicurazioni). employee_rate 9.19% (IVS+NASpI). employer_rate 26.76% flat (no size tiers); source: kitech.it/Contributi-previdenziali.aspx?p=9_165 (proxy — SIMPLIFICATION: dati proxy, verificare circolare INPS). No size-tier pages for credito on kitech.it (industria has separate tier pages), corroborating flat structure. Fondo di solidarietà del credito (bilateral, substitutes FIS/CIGO/CIGS) is sector-specific and presumed included in the aggregate 26.76% — not double-counted (SIMPLIFICATION: verify against INPS circolari).
fixed_term_additional_rate: NASpI addizionale base rate 1.4% (employer-only) per Art. 2 co. 28 L. 92/2012.
